The structure of Li4Bi8F16 (reduced formula LiBi2F4) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 28 atoms in the unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi and Li centers each with eight fluorine neighbors in body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements, while F centers have nine geometric neighbors (1 Bi, 1 Li, 7 F). Corner-sharing is observed between Bi and Li eight-vertex polyhedra, as well as among Bi polyhedra, with corner, edge, and face sharing among F-centered nine-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 28 sites.
